desc: Online co-op, three games on the local relay, the host playing the full run's segment 3 from its checkpoint: down to the sewers, the three Goomba goons fought together; guest 2 leaves the room mid-fight (back to its own file) and joins the same code again, taking its seat back ('welcome back'); everyone follows the host east to the moving platform's walkway, where all three games agree (same room, story, partner, Mario's place, settled) while the host's Start menu holds the world; then the host leaves the room and both guests are told and go back to their own adventures

log_must: co-op: seat 3's player 3 is gone: the seat is free
co-op: player 3 is back: seat 3 again
end: back to the player's own adventure
